mapper.select:
SELECT p.*, a.user_name AS applyUserName, m.user_name AS approveUserName FROM approve_record p LEFT JOIN `user` a ON a.user_id=p.apply_user_id LEFT JOIN `user` m ON m.user_id=p.approve_user_id
AND a.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{applyUserName}, '%')
AND m.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{approveUserName}, '%')
AND p.approve_status = #{approveStatus}
ORDER BY p.approve_id ASC
